semantic_model.name: research_workspace
semantic_model.description: Private owner research state. Public readers consume explicit published projections, not these tables.

ai_context.instructions: Interpret source, owner, and machine-proposed statements separately. These definitions are metadata; execute only registered permission-scoped API operations.

datasets.name: records
datasets.description: One stable work/edition/passage/concept/claim/note identity per row; kind and source-specific attributes retain their distinctions.

datasets.name: relations
datasets.description: One explicit directed assertion; its predicate and provenance determine its meaning.

datasets.name: personal_states
datasets.description: Private personal progress and screening; never a scholarly quality score.

datasets.name: reading_documents
datasets.description: One immutable private source-version excerpt identity. Full document text is intentionally absent from this semantic metadata contract.

datasets.name: reading_annotations
datasets.description: One private located captured quotation and editable owner note per identity. Unicode code-point positions and source hash do not establish scholarly review.

datasets.name: scripture_citations
datasets.description: One private owner reference decision per captured quotation and candidate key. Confirmed means resolved reference only; explicit detection, owner mapping, and interpretation remain distinct. Dismissed rows have no resolved target.

datasets.name: lexicon_entries
datasets.description: Private owner-scoped lexical entries. Equal spellings are not identity or translation equivalence.

datasets.name: lexicon_forms
datasets.description: Grammatical realizations of entries; undetermined until explicitly classified. Orthographic variants are representations, not inferred new forms.

datasets.name: lexicon_representations
datasets.description: Exact original spelling and declared language/script/transliteration, linked to a located origin annotation. Normalized retrieval keys are intentionally absent.

datasets.name: lexicon_senses
datasets.description: Private scoped entry-concept assertions, pending scholarly review. This dataset join is not a published OntoLex entailment.

datasets.name: lexicon_definitions
datasets.description: Located attributed definition assertions. Source-explicit, reference gloss, owner paraphrase, and recorded machine proposals stay distinct; no automatic review promotion.

datasets.name: lexicon_occurrences
datasets.description: Exact Unicode term positions relative to the captured quotation and immutable source document/hash. Private occurrences and reading dates do not assert historical influence.

datasets.name: verse_materials
datasets.description: Private owner-declared verse material. Typed representation/citation/discussion/interpretation and immutable source target; citation_snapshot retains original evidence even when the current citation changes. Dataset joins are lineage only, not scholarly entailment.

datasets.name: reading_desks
datasets.description: Private confirmed reading place per project. Stable source/document/annotation lineage, not a scholarly graph edge, reading comprehension score or public state.

datasets.name: notebook_entries
datasets.description: Private owner thoughts with explicit source anchors and explained links. Pending review; existing passage-note bodies are not copied into these entries. Connections describe owner rationale, not scholarly entailment.

metrics.name: record_count
metrics.description: Count of visible records at record grain; apply permission/project filters before aggregation.

metrics.name: read_count

dialects.expression: COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN personal_states.reading = 'read' THEN personal_states.record_id END)

metrics.description: Private owner reading progress; not evaluation or verification.

custom_extensions.data: {"research_platform": {"policy_document": "../src/islam_research/policies/research-policy.json", "policy_version": 1, "authorization": "backend-enforced; metadata is not permission", "execution": "registered operations only; never execute model-supplied SQL"}}
